posts.author: Milu
posts.body:
I've started making some graphics for MZ, and I'll share them here. Most of these probably will be tileset edits.
*
Terms of use:
You may edit these graphics. If you use them in your projects, you can credit me as Milu (I appreciate if you do. I won't be mad if you don't
).
The graphics are edits of the default RMMZ graphics, unless stated otherwise. They are free to use in non-commercial and commercial Rpg Maker MZ projects, and with other rpg makers that you own (if you also have MZ).
Some of the graphics (I have indicated which) are combinations of Rpg Maker MZ and Rpg Maker MV graphics. Using those requires that you also have Rpg Maker MV.
My original work can be freely used anywhere, also in other games or purposes, except: please don't use these graphics as AI training material.
*
The graphics:
A2 (carpets and floors, mostly color edits):
Spoiler:
A2 Floor
Outside A4 + other stuff:
Some MV+MZ combined hills/mountains and greenery, edited to match the MZ default outside tile colours (Requires both RMMZ and RMMV)
Spoiler:
Outside MZ+MV
Some details to add to the hill/mountain (example included)
B-E: Window & table set, green and red, combination of RMMV and RMMZ graphics. (Requires both RMMZ and RMMV)
Spoiler:
B-E Windows&table (MV+MZ)

posts.author: Milu
posts.body:
Today, I added some A4 outside rounded hills & greenery. These are MV+MZ combined graphics that are colour edited to match MZ default outside or at least each other. Included, among others:
* My version of less sharp-edged forest autotile
* Hills/mountains. And some details (mostly colour edited from default tilesets) to match the one that's edited from A4_dungeon
I'm not totally satisfied with the autotiles, but they function well enough for me, for now... (Might edit them later or might not, I'm not super skilled)
Here's an example, the rest are in the original post
*

posts.body: I like the rocks! It looks more natural how you set it up, great job!
